exposure: Successful TOLAC vs. operative vaginal delivery
duration of the second stage of labor
Implementation of ACOG guidelines extending the second stage of labor
trial of labor after caesarean section (TOLAC)
Time period (before vs. after implementation of ACOG guidelines in 2014)
outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
Transfer rate to neonatal care unit
cohort: 1546 patients undergoing trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) at two large departments in Germany from January 2008 to January 2018
finding: Extending the second stage of labor, as per the 2014 ACOG guidelines, did not increase VBAC success rates, and while maternal and neonatal outcomes were similar between groups, the transfer rate to the neonatal care unit was higher after guideline implementation.
